responsibility: Implements text-diagnostic support for explaining macro-expansion provenance. Given a location produced by libcpp macro expansion, this file walks line-map macro stacks, resolves both definition and expansion points, and appends note diagnostics showing 'in definition of macro' and 'in expansion of macro' context; it also provides a text finalizer that front ends can install so classic text output emits macro-unwinding notes after the main diagnostic.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation for the macro-unwinding pair: it walks libcpp line-map macro-expansion stacks and emits the note diagnostics and finalizer behavior, whereas macro-unwinding.h only declares those hooks.
